moments.author: Dawn Staley
moments.quote: If you only knew….or thought outside of your box. … I’ll let you carry on.
moments.why: Her rebuke to a reporter defending coverage of her players went viral among sports fans and generated widespread discussion.

moments.author: Mario, PT
moments.quote: If you want me to think like an owner, are you willing to give me 50% of the company?
moments.why: That bold Gen‑Z response to being told to 'think like an owner' ignited a massive online debate on labor expectations vs compensation.
